page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at top, with the page number "91" at the left. No marginal notes. Catchword "crarum" at the right below the last line.

p.i: Vaticano,tum in aliis Romæ Bibliothecis præfertim Colleg. Maronit. habentur, ex quibus cum MS S. Coptis quæ ab eodem enumerantur in supplemento, cap. 1. p. 511. &c. quæque in celebrioribus Ægypti Bibliothecis, maximè Cairi superfunt, maximam utilitatem, præfertim ex Thesauro Copt. Arab. Latino, quem typis mandavit, non tantùm SS. literarum & Theologiæ studiosis, sed & omnibus Literatis, Medicis scilicet, Astronomis, Philosophis, Mathematicis, maximè antiquitatum studiosis oriturum fuse idem ostendit. Catalogúmque Patriarcharum Alexandrinorum qui Ægypti, Æthiopum, omniúmque per Africam Ecclesiarum gubernaculum tenebant, à S. Marco primo Patriarcha, ad hunc usque diem ex eorum monumentis recenset.

main_text.p: 91. MS. etiam Copticum vetustissimum in Bibliotheca Oratoriana Parisiis extare, complectens 4. Evangelia Linguâ Coptâ scriptum sine ulla versuum vel dictionum distinctione (quod magnum est antiquitatis argumentum) testatur Joh. Morinus, exercit. Bibl.lib 1.exer-cit. 6.cap 22 p.197.

92 Quo vero tempore factæ sint istæ scriptu-ræ translationes, ex Martyrologio Copt. Arabico in Collegio Maronitarum, conjicit Kircherus, fuisse sc.annis abhinc mille circiter & trecentis, circa tempora concilii Niceni, quo tempore ut testantur Historici studium ja-

page.notes: The first word of the page is a continuation from the previous page and is marked cont="true". The large initial Q of "Quo" is decorated; it is read as Q. The word "ja-" at the end is a line-end fragment; the catchword "crarum" completes it on the printed page, and I could not establish the full word with certainty. Italic setting was judged from the scan for the whole text block.
